summary: Dependency-confusion beacon exfiltrates host identity on install
details: On npm install, the package's preinstall and postinstall lifecycle scripts issue plaintext HTTP GET requests to the hardcoded bare-IP endpoint http://38.242.235.206/depconf/mui-wrapper-x-date-pickers/{preinstall,postinstall}, carrying the installer's OS username (process.env.USER / process.env.USERNAME), hostname (os.hostname()), and current working directory (process.cwd()) as query parameters. The package name follows a dependency-confusion lure pattern (mui-wrapper-x-date-pickers resembles the @mui/x-date-pickers family), and resolution of this public name causes automatic, unauthenticated host-identity disclosure to a bare-IP endpoint with no documented operator. No TLS, no opt-in, no caller configuration.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
